notes: Mississippi's All-State Honor Choirs are run jointly by the Mississippi Music Educators Association (MSMEA, msmea.org) and the Mississippi chapter of the American Choral Directors Association (MSACDA, msacda.org). MSACDA hosts the choir-specific materials (repertoire, audition selections, rehearsal tracks, chairs) and MSMEA hosts the timeline and division calendars; MSMEA's own All-State Honor Choir page simply points to MSACDA. The All-State Honor Choirs meet at the joint MMEA/ACDA State Conference. IMPORTANT SEASON LABEL: Mississippi calls this cycle '2026' — the '2026 MMEA-ACDA All-State Conference' is November 16-18, 2026 at The University of Southern Mississippi, Hattiesburg, with auditions in August 2026. That falls in the 2026-27 school year, so it is recorded here as season 2026-27 while preserving the state's own '2026' wording in titles. The conference date is noted on MSACDA's site as a 'New Date' (moved from the association's usual January slot). MSACDA's Honor Choir section was updated July 28, 2026.

organization.name: Mississippi American Choral Directors Association
organization.description: MSACDA is the Mississippi chapter of the American Choral Directors Association, which states its mission as inspiring excellence in choral music in Mississippi through education, performance, composition, and advocacy. It administers the Mississippi All-State Honor Choirs (SATB and Treble) and the MS All-State Show Choir jointly with the Mississippi Music Educators Association, and co-hosts the annual MMEA/MSACDA State Conference.
